items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: we had trombones under there with Jack Jenny and Buddy Morrow

ctx.x: They would count every part. Now then, we had trombones under there with Jack Jenny and Buddy Morrow and several other guys that could really belt it out, and those guys stood up.
We used to do this in a theater down on 46th Street, and they used to stand up and just blow it out. And you had to do that for 16 bars.
